meta_description: LL PlasterMaster is a Manchester plasterer specialising in internal finishing, repairs and decorative work. Free quotes, fast turnaround. Call 07719 253173.
hero_subhead: Cracked plasterwork, damp walls or botched repairs? We fix it first time, cleanly and on schedule.
services_heading: Complete Plastering Services Across Greater Manchester
services_subhead: From emergency repairs and ceiling skimming to decorative finishes, we handle every interior plastering job with precision and care.

services.title: Wall Skimming & Replastering
services.desc: Smooth, professional finishes on walls damaged by damp, cracks or previous poor work. We prep, plaster and leave surfaces ready for paint or wallpaper.

services.title: Ceiling Repairs & Installation
services.desc: Sagging, cracked or stained ceilings restored to near-new condition. Includes plasterboard fixing, joint treatment and dust-free finishing.

services.title: Artexed Surface Removal
services.desc: Safe removal of textured Artex coatings and replacement with clean, modern skimmed finishes. Fully contained, minimal mess.

services.title: Damp Damage Repairs
services.desc: Plaster stripped, walls dried and relined to prevent salt damage and future bloom. We work with your surveyor's recommendations.

services.title: Coving & Cornicing
services.desc: Decorative plaster coving fitted and finished to a professional standard, adding character and a quality edge to room corners.

services.title: Emergency Plasterwork
services.desc: Burst pipes, accidental damage or urgent decoration work? We respond quickly to minimise disruption and get you back on track.

about_pullquote: I plaster to the standard I'd want in my own home — no shortcuts, no mess.
about_para_1: LL PlasterMaster was founded on a simple principle: homes deserve plasterers who care about detail and finish. With over a decade of experience across Manchester, we've built a reputation for tackling awkward jobs that other tradespeople sidestep — cracked ceilings, damp-damaged walls, and botched repairs. Every job is treated as a craft, not a race.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we show up on time, we explain what we're doing, and the work looks immaculate when we leave. We're not the flashiest outfit in town — we're the one your neighbour actually recommends when their wall needs fixing properly. That's the reputation we've earned, and it's the one we protect every single day.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Homeowners Say About LL PlasterMaster

reviews.text: Came out to fix a ceiling that had cracks everywhere. Left it looking perfect — honestly can't tell where the damage was. No faffing about, just solid work. Cheers mate.
reviews.author: David H.

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with water damage after a pipe burst. Plasterman removed all the damaged plaster, dried it out properly and finished it beautifully. Fair price and turned it around in a week. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Catherine B.

reviews.text: Removed our Artex and re-skimmed the whole lounge ceiling. Didn't expect it to look this good. He's clearly been doing this for years — knows every trick to avoid mess and dust. Will definitely book him again for the kitchen.
reviews.author: Michael T.
